recalled_knowledge.item: Baxter-2021 SHM: v0 = 238, v_esc = 544, v_sun,pec = (11.1, 12.2, 7.3) km/s, rho0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (via lzcommon)
Mean inverse speed of a boosted Maxwellian, eta = [erf(x+y) - erf(x-y)]/(2 y v0) (v_esc -> infinity)
G_F = 1.166e-5 GeV^-2, sin^2 theta_W = 0.231; Higgsino Z couplings c_p = (G_F/sqrt2)(1-4 s_W^2), c_n = -G_F/sqrt2
Earth orbital speed 29.8 km/s; projection onto the solar-motion direction ~15 km/s; peak ~2 June
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: standard annual-modulation kinematics (Freese, Frieman, Gould 1988); WimPyDD v_earth_sun

recalled_knowledge.item: Sagittarius stream near the Sun: v ~ 300 km/s roughly perpendicular to the disk; local density fraction <~ few % (early claims 0.3-25 %)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Freese, Gondolo, Newberg, Lewis PRL 92, 111301 (2004); Purcell, Zentner, Wang JCAP 08 (2012) 027

recalled_knowledge.item: S1 stream: retrograde, Galactocentric (v_r, v_phi, v_z) ~ (-34, -306, -64) km/s, dispersions ~(82, 27, 59) km/s, lab-frame ~ 500-575 km/s, density fraction up to ~10 % considered
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Myeong et al. ApJL 863, L28 (2018); O'Hare et al. PRD 98, 103006 (2018)

recalled_knowledge.item: S2 stream prograde with large vertical velocity (~(6, 164, -250) km/s); retrograde 'shards' (Rg-type) with v_phi ~ -(250-300) km/s and small fractions
Gaia-Enceladus/Sausage debris: v_phi ~ 0, |v_r| ~ 200-300 km/s, strongly radial, ~20 % of local density (SHM++)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Belokurov et al. 2018; Evans, O'Hare, McCabe PRD 99, 023012 (2019)

recalled_knowledge.item: Helmi streams: prograde with large |v_z| (~250 km/s), local fraction <~ 1 %
Galactic escape speed at the Sun 500-580 km/s (RAVE 533, Gaia ~528)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Piffl et al. 2014; Deason et al. 2019 (as in P018)

recalled_knowledge.item: Unbound/extragalactic dark matter near the Sun is a small fraction (<< 1 %) of the local density
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Freese, Gondolo, Stodolsky PRD 64, 123502 (2001) and Local Group modelling

recalled_knowledge.item: Cold tidal streams of dwarf-galaxy debris have internal dispersions ~10-30 km/s

failed_or_abandoned: Run 1 failed on an invalid keyword identifier (delta_N_1e-3_of_300); renamed.

The 3-D shell quadrature copied from P018 (48 x 64 angular nodes) cannot resolve a sigma = 20 km/s stream at 800 km/s (1.4 deg): untruncated eta0 came out 4.4-6.7 % high; replaced by the exact axisymmetric integral (valid for streams anti-parallel to v_obs), which reproduces the analytic stream to 5e-7.

Untruncated Gaussian streams overstate bound-stream rates above delta ~ 380 keV (by x60 at delta = 400 keV for v_gal = 544); kept only for unbound streams and as an upper envelope, flagged where used.
